full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a surgically resected specimen of bowel with associated mesentery and a prominent mass. The specimen exhibits a firm, whitish, well-circumscribed tumor involving the intestinal wall and mesentery. The tissue appearance is consistent with a primary gastrointestinal neoplasm or metastatic tumor, such as a gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) or desmoid tumor.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen of the appendix. The specimen shows severe inflammation and dark discoloration characteristic of acute appendicitis with gangrene. The wall of the appendix is thickened and erythematous, with visible areas of necrosis and purulent exudate. These findings are diagnostic of acute gangrenous appendicitis.
